symbols.name: TemporalCarry

symbols.name: TemporalCarry.to_dict
symbols.note: Returns dict with keys 'scores' and 'evidence', converting each to dict.

symbols.name: carry_temporal_scores
symbols.note: Carries old relevance scores through exact IDs and rename evidence. Returns TemporalCarry.

symbols.name: RelationChannel

symbols.name: _relation_adjacencies
